recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is and do not reintroduce Consent.policy.authority for FHIR-11060; later non-final R6 policy-clarity issues should be handled separately by the work group.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU2 Consent issue requesting Consent.policy become a structure with authority 0..1 uri for the entity or organization with regulatory jurisdiction/accountability and uri 0..1 uri for the policy.
initial_application: Commit 687d10304f explicitly listed GF#11060 and added Consent.policy as a backbone with authority and uri children in the Consent spreadsheet, so the original tracker was applied historically.
additional_context: FHIR-32817 later replaced Consent.policy and Consent.policyRule with regulatoryBasis, policyBasis, and policyText for R5. Current source keeps that model, FHIR-43331/FHIR-43326 later clarify or retain it without restoring policy.authority, and FHIR-45450 only renamed policyBasis.url back to policyBasis.uri.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because current build-scoped Consent source is correct under the later final model: regulatoryBasis records regulatory context and policyBasis.reference/uri identifies the computable policy the organization will enforce.

related_jiras.note: Published Consent decision replacing Consent.policy and Consent.policyRule with regulatoryBasis, policyBasis, and policyText.

Resolved - No Change issue declining removal of policyBasis and noting opt-in/opt-out were removed in R5.
Applied issue changing policyBasis.url back to policyBasis.uri, matching current source.
